item.title: My wife says we can’t afford to retire. I vetoed her $8,000 trip to Italy. We’re in our 60s and have $4 million. Do I keep working?

item.description: “I worry about healthcare, long-term care, inflation, a long bear market and living to 95.”

item.title: I’m 64 with two sons, but only one works in the family business. Is it ethical to leave him 70% of the company?

item.description: “I have some reservations about the long-term stability of my younger son’s marriage.”

item.title: I’m 63 and diagnosed with lymphoma. Should I take my Social Security next year?

item.description: “My plan is to continue working as long as I’m able to do so and invest my Social Security benefits while I’m still earning a paycheck.”
